name: Heresh
title: Son of Caleb
summary: Heresh was a son of Caleb, from the tribe of Judah. He is mentioned in Chronicles as part of Caleb's lineage. Although he is not a prominent figure in the Bible, his place in the genealogy is important for tracing the inheritance line of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Caleb's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Heresh is mentioned as one of the sons of Caleb, son of Hezron, in the genealogical record of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Inheritance Line of the Tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Heresh is listed as part of the significant lineage of the tribe of Judah, which was central to Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: Father of Elasa
keyEvents.description: Heresh is mentioned as the father of Elasa, thus continuing Caleb's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's descendants in the Promised Land
keyEvents.description: As part of Caleb's family, Heresh was among those who inherited land in the region of Judah after the conquest of Canaan.
